title: The agent fills a Flow and hands it over instead of running it blind
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-889 - The agent works INSIDE the app, not beside it: it reads the workspace, moves the view, and hands a Flow over (consolidation sweep 2026-09-22). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-889/plan.md.

PHASE 3. Reshaped by Fabio 2026-09-30: each Flow says how the agent uses it (agentOpens: Draw It In, Scribble, Object Stamp open for the user to finish; Song opens filled at Generate; every other Flow the agent runs), and the agent can open any Flow filled in on the user's screen instead of running it (a missing voice sample, 'let me adjust it'). Brief: brief.md.
